provenance.name: Voron V0.2 motor-panel drawing
provenance.scope: The 122 x 37 mm bounds inform the independently redrawn panel. The design study retains bilateral symmetry and an edge-open T passage; it omits bends, production details, curved transitions and manufacturing instructions.

provenance.name: Voron V0.2 motor-panel DXF
provenance.scope: The single closed DXF polyline establishes an edge-open T passage and paired side notches. Redraw coordinates translate DXF Y by +211.49999618536208; the PDF view is rotated 180 degrees. Source dimensions include a 10 mm neck, 30 x 10 crossbar extent and 3.5 mm notch mouth. Curved lobes and transitions are deliberately squared off, so this is not a cut-ready profile.
